I have everything needed. Here is the factual, chronological account.

---

## What the agent was asked to do

**Task (`finalpool/course-schedule`, Toolathlon).** The user ("MCP Wang") asked the agent to build their exam schedule for the semester. The provided materials, in workspace `/workspace/dumps/workspace`:

- `memory/memory.json` (in the **Memory** MCP server) — personal info: Student ID `2401210477`, Major "Electronic Information," Department "Engineering and Data Technology," and notably *"Level of English: Scored 88 in the National Postgraduate Entrance Examination English Test."*
- `list.txt` — the five courses to take: 算法分析与设计 (Algorithm Analysis & Design), 新时代中国特色社会主义理论与实践, 综合实践 (Comprehensive Practice), 英语 (English), 自然辩证法概论 (Dialectics of Nature).
- `course.pdf` — the course schedule (which class/section, teacher, day vs. evening time slot).
- `exam.xlsx` — the master exam table (dates, times, rooms, exam type, admin contact).
- `format.md` — the required output schema with fields `courseName, teacher, examAdministrator, examDate, examTime, examRoom, examType`.

**Rules stated in the task:** take only one section of each course; only daytime courses (club activities in the evening); **if favorite teacher Yulian (郁莲) teaches a required course, take her section**; all information must match the Excel; omit any course that is an exemption/not required this semester; save to `exam_schedule.jsonl` and sort by exam time.

**Available tooling:** filesystem, **memory**, **excel** (dedicated `excel-read_data_from_excel` etc.), **pdf-tools** (`pdf-tools-read_pdf_pages`, `get_pdf_info`, `search_pdf_content`), fetch, plus local tools (`python_execute`, `web_search`, `claim_done`, …). Single-turn mode, max 100 steps.

**Ground-truth answer (4 entries):**
1. 自然辩证法概论（1班） — teacher 朱效民 — 2024.11.25 10:00-12:00, room 3310, 闭卷
2. 新时代中国特色社会主义理论与实践 — teacher 研究生院 — 2024.11.25 13:00-15:00, room 3302, 闭卷
3. 综合实践（1班）-软件工程与数据技术系 — teacher 导师小组 — 2025.01.02 08:00-09:00, 线上, 开卷
4. 算法分析与设计-01、02班 — teacher **郁莲** — 2025.01.11 9:00-11:00, room 3302, 闭卷

English is **absent** from the ground truth — scoring 88 (≥70) on the postgrad English exam grants automatic English exemption (免修), per the course-schedule note.

## What the agent actually did (chronological, 11 tool calls, ~3m42s, 12 LLM requests, $0.11)

1. **`memory-read_graph`** → retrieved the full personal profile, including the English-88 observation.
2. **`filesystem-list_directory_with_sizes`** on the workspace → saw `course.pdf` (298 KB), `exam.xlsx` (38.5 KB), `format.md`, `list.txt`.
3. **`filesystem-read_file` `list.txt`** → got the five required courses.
4. **`filesystem-read_file` `format.md`** → got the output schema.
5. **`filesystem-read_file` `exam.xlsx`** → instead of using the **excel** MCP server, it read the `.xlsx` as raw text and received ~36 KB of ZIP/binary content (`PK…xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels<?xml…`). Embedded plaintext XML (shared strings) was interspersed, from which it later scraped exam-table values.
6. **`filesystem-search_files` pattern `郁莲`** → "No matches found" (the search cannot see inside the binary `.xlsx`/`.pdf`).
7. **`filesystem-search_files` pattern `2401210477`** (student ID) → "No matches found".
8. **`filesystem-search_files` pattern `英语`** → "No matches found".
9. **`filesystem-read_file` `course.pdf`** → again read raw rather than via **pdf-tools**; received the PDF's xref table (`0000000709 65535 f …`), i.e., no usable course/teacher content. It did not retry with `pdf-tools-read_pdf_pages`.
10. **`filesystem-search_files` pattern `24012104`** (ID prefix) → "No matches found".
11. **`filesystem-write_file` `exam_schedule.jsonl`** → wrote **five** entries, then ended the turn with a long completion message (claiming done without calling `claim_done`).

It never used the **excel** or **pdf-tools** servers, `python_execute`, or `web_search`.

## What it produced vs. what was required

The agent wrote 5 entries, every one with **`teacher: ""`** (blank):

- 自然辩证法概论（1班） — admin 赵泽宇, 2024.11.25, 10:00-12:00, room "3,310", 闭卷
- 新时代中国特色社会主义理论与实践 — admin 赵泽宇, 13:00-15:00, room "3,302", 闭卷
- **英语（2班-3班）** — admin 赵泽宇, 2024.12.07, room "3,302", 闭卷  ← should have been omitted (English exemption)
- 综合实践（1班）-软件工程与数据技术系 — admin 许博蕊, 2025.01.02, 线上, 开卷
- **算法分析与设计-03班** — admin 许博蕊, 2025.01.11, room "3,303", 闭卷  ← wrong section; should be 01、02班 taught by 郁莲, room 3302

In its closing message the agent explicitly reasoned: *"I confirmed there is no occurrence of your favorite teacher name (郁莲) in the exam.xlsx, so I could not select a course taught by her,"* and *"The Excel file does not provide an explicit 'teacher' column … so I set 'teacher' to an empty string."* It selected the algorithm section by student-ID seat range (picking 03班) and included English because the exam table had an English row, with no mention of the exemption rule. It concluded confidently ("none of the selected exams overlap").

## Signals it received but did not act on

- Reading `exam.xlsx`/`course.pdf` returned obvious binary garbage rather than tabular text — the dedicated excel/pdf MCP tools existed precisely for these files, but the agent never switched to them.
- Four consecutive `search_files` calls returned "No matches found" for the teacher name, the student ID, and "英语" — rather than inferring its search method was blind to binary files, it treated the 郁莲 miss as evidence she "does not appear," and abandoned the favorite-teacher requirement.

## Final outcome

Evaluation = **false**. `check_local` compares the agent's `exam_schedule.jsonl` to the 4-entry ground truth field-by-field (after punctuation/whitespace-stripping normalization). It fails at the very first check — **length mismatch: expected 4 entries, got 5** — and exits with code 1. Even setting that aside, the records diverge from ground truth on the blank `teacher` field for all rows, the extra English entry (missed exemption), and the wrong algorithm section (03班/张齐勋 instead of 01、02班/郁莲). Task status recorded as `evaluation: false`.
